name: Whisper Subtitles
description: Automatically generate AI-powered subtitles for your media library using OpenAI Whisper. Supports translation, multiple models (tiny to large + turbo), word-level timestamps, and intelligent subtitle detection.
overview: Generate accurate subtitles using OpenAI's Whisper AI model with GPU acceleration support

versions.changelog: Enhance configuration page logging and error handling for improved debugging

Critical Fix - Cache Directory Permissions
- Fixed UnauthorizedAccessException when accessing cache directory
- Improved cache directory detection for container environments
- Added fallback to temp directory if HOME is not available
- Better error handling for directory creation
- Plugin now initializes properly without crashing
- Configuration page now works correctly

UI Improvements
- Fixed configuration page checkboxes to use proper emby-checkbox components
- Improved checkbox rendering with is="emby-checkbox" attributes
- Better visual consistency with Jellyfin 10.11 web UI
- Fixed checkbox default value handling
- Pinned to Jellyfin 10.11.2 package versions

Jellyfin 10.11.2 Support - Verified Working Release
- Pinned to exact Jellyfin 10.11.2 package versions (not 10.11.3)
- Minimal package with only essential DLLs (Jellyfin.Plugin.WhisperSubtitles.dll + Whisper.net.dll)
- Fixed all assembly version mismatches
- Compatible with Jellyfin Server 10.11.2
- Note: Whisper models must be installed separately on the system

Jellyfin 10.11.2 Support - Fixed Version Compatibility
- Fixed to use exact Jellyfin 10.11.2 package versions
- Minimal package with only essential DLLs
- Fixed AssemblyVersion to match Jellyfin 10.11.2.0 ABI
- Note: Whisper models must be installed separately on the system

Jellyfin 10.11 Support
- Updated to target Jellyfin 10.11.x with .NET 9.0
- Removed dependency injection registration (not supported in 10.11)
- Services now instantiated directly in tasks
- Full compatibility with Jellyfin 10.11.2+

Bug fixes
- Fixed dependency injection registration (implement IPluginServiceRegistrator)
- Fixed configuration page embedding
- Corrected RegisterServices method signature for Jellyfin 10.8 compatibility

Initial release
- Core subtitle generation with Whisper.NET
- Support for all Whisper models (tiny, base, small, medium, large, turbo)
- Translation to English from any language
- Word-level timestamps
- AI identifier in filenames
- Scheduled task for manual generation
- Auto-generation after library scans
- Skip existing subtitles
- Regenerate AI subtitles option
- Multi-platform support (Windows, Linux, macOS)
